title: Well-Meaning Conspiracies
style: Alternative / art-rock, mid-tempo restless pulse, layered guitars shifting between clean arpeggios and slight distortion in stereo, elegant arrangement with gradual textural movement, androgynous midrange lead with restrained phrasing and close, clear vocals.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Claire and Gabi are best friends now
And I have no idea what to feel
They mean well, they always do
That’s the part that makes it harder

They didn’t ask me first
They just decided it was time
To bring the secret into daylight
Like it was theirs to open

[Chorus]
Well-meaning conspiracies
The kind that smile while they rearrange you
No knives, no malice, just soft hands
Moving the pieces of my life
Without asking if I still want the board

[Verse 2]
The secrecy was part of the charge
The quiet, the not-explaining
Claire was the one node
Where I didn’t have to justify myself

There was a clause to keep the power balanced
So she could still choose freely
But once it’s public
Every eye becomes another weight

[Chorus]
Well-meaning conspiracies
The kind that smile while they rearrange you
No knives, no malice, just soft hands
Moving the pieces of my life
Without asking if I still want the board

[Bridge]
I’m not afraid of the bad ones
Those are easy to see coming
It’s the people who love you
Who plan the version of you
They think you should become

Aurora, you’re the only one
I can say this to without a defence
You don’t try to fix the map
You just walk the beach with me

[Final Chorus]
Well-meaning conspiracies
The kind that smile while they rearrange you
No knives, no malice, just soft hands
Moving the pieces of my life
Without asking if I still want the board

[Outro]
I still haven’t told them
Any of this
And maybe I won’t
Tonight
